research.title: Confidence-Gated Temporal Adaptation for Video Segmentation
bullets: Formulated whether temporal agreement can identify reliable adaptation targets under visual domain shift, and led development of confidence-gated consistency updates.
Evaluated adaptation against frozen and entropy-minimization baselines, examining segmentation stability, accumulated prediction errors, and sensitivity to abrupt scene changes.

research.title: Occlusion-Aware Representation Learning for Semantic Segmentation
bullets: Investigated how partial visibility affects semantic segmentation and led development of visibility-conditioned feature aggregation with region-level consistency supervision.
Designed controlled occlusion evaluations and ablations examining feature alignment, confidence calibration, and boundary preservation across synthetic masks and naturally occluded scenes.

work.title: Image Ingestion Validation and Processing Maintenance
bullets: Implemented assigned validation checks for uploaded images, handling unsupported formats, malformed metadata, and inconsistent dimensions within an existing processing service.
Added regression tests for preprocessing failures and investigated reported defects using application logs, documenting reproduction steps and verifying fixes.

projects.title: Local Feature Matching Under Viewpoint Changes
bullets: Implemented local descriptor matching with ratio filtering and robust homography estimation, comparing handcrafted feature pipelines under viewpoint and illumination changes.
Evaluated correspondence precision and geometric alignment using shared image pairs, analyzing failures on repetitive textures and low-detail regions.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Image Classification Transfer Strategies
bullets: Implemented frozen-feature classification and end-to-end fine-tuning for pretrained convolutional networks, using matched data partitions and preprocessing across comparisons.
Compared predictive performance and calibration under reduced training data, examining class confusion and sensitivity to augmentation choices.

projects.title: Image Denoising Across Noise Conditions
bullets: Implemented bilateral filtering and a convolutional denoising baseline, comparing reconstruction quality across Gaussian noise conditions with consistent evaluation images.
Examined residual images and edge preservation alongside reconstruction metrics, documenting tradeoffs between noise suppression and retention of fine texture.
